claims.claim: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said the SLS changes aim to raise flight rates and cut costs until commercial lunar options arrive in the 2030s.
claims.episode_span: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said the changes aim to raise SLS flight rates and cut costs until commercial lunar options arrive in the 2030s.
claims.source_title: NASA Administrator on SLS, Centaur V stretch and ML-2
claims.supporting_quote: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has further explained the decision to standardize the Space Launch System (SLS), move toward a stretched Centaur V upper stage, and stop work on Mobile Launcher 2 (ML-2), linking those choices to higher flight rates and lower costs.

claims.claim: The first SINGULUS production line is scheduled for delivery in the first half of 2027.
claims.episode_span: The first line is scheduled for delivery in the first half of 2027, with additional lines planned under the strategic partnership.
claims.source_title: SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES Announces Major Supply Contract with SpaceX for Advanced HJT Solar Cell Manufacturing Equipment
claims.supporting_quote: The first production line will be delivered in the first half of 2027, and production will scale to support more than 100 GW of production equipment as SpaceX accelerates satellite manufacturing in Bastrop, Texas.
